C0695.title: Taobao Penalties for Dropshipping Sellers
C0695.summary: Taobao's penalty rules for dropshipping stores: first violation leads to removal of all products and a 7-day listing ban; second and subsequent violations result in a 12-point deduction, immediate removal of all products, a 30-day listing ban, and a 20,000 yuan penalty paid to Tmall.
